commands: echo "RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID ATTEMPT=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"; echo "---status---"; git status --porcelain | head -20; echo "---prview---"; gh pr view 1279 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,body,closingIssuesReferences --jq '{headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,closes:[.closingIssuesReferences[].number]}'

RUN_ID=$(printf '%s-%s' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"); echo "run-id=$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1279/$RUN_ID"; gh pr diff 1279 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1279/$RUN_ID/diff.patch" | wc -l

mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1279/$(printf '%s-%s' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}")"; gh pr diff 1279 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1279/$(printf '%s-%s' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}")/diff.patch" | wc -l

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
